limitations: No reconstruction of the distribution's kernel or firmware compiler environment was performed.

The supplied initramfs has no embedded package database; its file hashes are retained, and source recipes for its identified components are retained without claiming a file-by-file package provenance attestation.
The source bundle contains target component sources and recipe records. Native compiler/build-tool binaries are fetchable locked inputs, not included source-bundle artifacts.
